Confirmed that mlx2's existing DFlash2 drafter (provenance/muse-dflash2.json) matches Splash on: capture = residual stream after decoder layers 5/19/33/47/61 (0-based, before the final norm); fc -> hidden_norm context projection; two-tap causal dynamic conv with dynamic layout [stage][tap][group] and base [stage][tap][hidden], tap 0 current row, tap 1 previous row, no tap across the anchor; draft attention over 2047 retained context tokens plus the non-causal block; selector = top-16 draft logits + predecessor/successor codebook edges through the rank-256 projection of the final-normed hidden, walked from the anchor. Design input: the optional draft_quantization policy key quantizes the same tensor set Splash stores as Q4 (every projection; norms, conv base kernels and codebooks stay bf16).
